description: Share of women, 2023-24: Uttar Pradesh at work, Bihar with own phones.

Uttar Pradesh: 33.6% of women aged 15+ were at work, 2023-24. Bihar: 30.1%. India: 40.3%.
Uttar Pradesh: 31.7% of women aged 15+, calendar year 2025 (new design). Bihar: 24.0%.
Bihar: 62.8% of women aged 15 to 49 had a mobile phone they used. Uttar Pradesh: 56.4%. India: 64%.

Closing map: Women with a phone they use, every state (% of women aged 15 to 49 · India 63.6% · 2023-24). Survey estimate. Blank: Lakshadweep (small sample, not ranked) and Manipur (no NFHS-6 fact sheet yet). The table shows how much, not why.
